```{r}
run_rctd_doublet <- function(spe, sce_ref, out_prefix) {
  set.seed(9237)

  # data preparation
  rctd_data <- createRctd(
    spatial_experiment = spe,
    reference_experiment = sce_ref,
    cell_type_col = "subclusters",
    UMI_min = 10,
    UMI_min_sigma = 50,
  )

  # deconvolution in doublet mode
  results <- runRctd(rctd_data, rctd_mode = "doublet")

  pixels <- colnames(assay(results))

  first_type_map  <- setNames(colData(results)$first_type, pixels)
  second_type_map <- setNames(colData(results)$second_type, pixels)
  class_map       <- setNames(colData(results)$spot_class, pixels)

  spe$cell_type   <- first_type_map[as.character(spe$cell_id)]
  spe$second_type <- second_type_map[as.character(spe$cell_id)]
  spe$spot_class  <- class_map[as.character(spe$cell_id)]

  print(table(spe$spot_class, useNA = "ifany"))

  #assign("nuclei_list", replace(nuclei_list, out_prefix, spe), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  return(spe)

  #invisible(spe)
}
```

```{r}
blocco1_c26foxO_fibre <- run_rctd_doublet(blocco1_c26foxO_fibre, sce_ref, "c26_fox0")
```

#recupero annotazione da NowWhat/Tessera
```{r}
cell_type_fibre <- readRDS("~/data/cell_type_fibre.rds")
```


```{r}

results <- cell_type_fibre %>%
  # 1. FORCE dplyr's select function here
  dplyr::select(blocco, campione, cell_id, metodo, cell_type) %>%
  
  # 2. Group by sample identifiers
  group_by(blocco, campione) %>%
  nest() %>%
  
  # 3. Apply a function to calculate the indices for each sample
  mutate(
    comparisons = purrr::map(data, function(sample_data) {
      
      # Pivot wider so each method has its own column of cell_types
      wide_data <- sample_data %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = metodo, values_from = cell_type)
      
      # Identify the method columns (everything except cell_id)
      method_cols <- setdiff(names(wide_data), "cell_id")
      
      # If there's only 1 method in this sample, we can't compare
      if (length(method_cols) < 2) return(NULL)
      
      # Generate all pairwise combinations of methods
      method_pairs <- combn(method_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE)
      
      # Calculate indices for each pair
      purrr::map_dfr(method_pairs, function(pair) {
        m1 <- pair[1]
        m2 <- pair[2]
        
        # Filter out cells that weren't classified by both methods
        valid_rows <- complete.cases(wide_data[[m1]], wide_data[[m2]])
        
        # Convert character labels to numeric factors for the functions
        labels1 <- as.numeric(as.factor(wide_data[[m1]][valid_rows]))
        labels2 <- as.numeric(as.factor(wide_data[[m2]][valid_rows]))
        
        # Calculate indices
        standard_ri <- fossil::rand.index(labels1, labels2)
        adjusted_ri <- mclust::adjustedRandIndex(labels1, labels2)
        
        # Return a row of results
        tibble(
          Method_A = m1,
          Method_B = m2,
          Cells_Compared = sum(valid_rows),
          Rand_Index = standard_ri,
          Adjusted_Rand_Index = adjusted_ri
        )
      })
    })
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. FORCE dplyr's select function here as well
  dplyr::select(-data) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(comparisons))

print(results)
writexl::write_xlsx(results, "rand_index_results.xlsx")
```
